_comment: Tidal Flight shared requirements and preliminary design-input file for mission, flight-performance, and constraint analyses.
_important: Values tagged RFP are confirmed requirements. Values tagged preliminary must be replaced as the team design matures.

geometry._src_span_limit_ft: Tidal Flight RFP: wingspan must be below 65 ft.

weights._src_A_exponent: Carried from the supplied IHW1/TTPA preliminary OEW regression.

legacy_segment_weight_fractions._src: Compatibility inputs carried from the supplied preliminary mission model. Cruise and loiter weight fractions are calculated separately.

aerodynamics._src_CD0_clean: Preliminary value carried from the supplied TTPA aerodynamic model.
aerodynamics._src_CLmax: Preliminary team assumptions; replace with high-lift aerodynamic results.
aerodynamics._src_configuration_increments: Preliminary values from the supplied constraint-analysis reference/Roskam-based assumptions.
aerodynamics._note_e: e_clean is the value produced by aero_polar.py for AR = 8 using e = 1.78*(1 - 0.045*AR^0.68) - 0.64. It is repeated here only for compatibility with the standalone constraint module.

propulsion._src_P_SL_hp: total installed sea-level shaft-power, constraint sizing should update this value.
propulsion._src_BSFC_and_prop_efficiency: Preliminary values carried from the supplied TTPA propulsion reference.
propulsion._src_power_lapse_exponent: Matches the sigma^0.8 turboshaft assumption hardcoded in seaplane_prop.py.

rfp_performance_requirements._note_cruise: The team-selected mission cruise is 130 KTAS, while the RFP separately requires 180-KTAS cruise capability at 10,000-ft density altitude.

_src_design_range_nmi: Converted from the RFP minimum range of 1,000 statute miles using 1 nmi = 1.15077945 statute miles.

std_mission._description: RFP compliance mission: takeoff, climb, 869-nmi cruise, arrival descent, balked-landing/reserve climb, 45-minute IFR reserve loiter, reserve descent, and landing.
std_mission._src_reserve_fuel_fraction: Preliminary additional trapped/unusable-energy allowance. The RFP's 45-minute reserve is explicitly represented by the loiter segment.
std_mission._src_cruise: Range and altitude from the RFP
std_mission._src_reserve: The RFP requires 45 minutes of IFR reserve energy and a balked landing at the beginning of the reserve segment.
std_mission._note_reserve_altitude_speed: The 4,000-ft and 120-KTAS reserve-loiter condition is preliminary and carried from the supplied reference mission.

typical_500nmi_route._description: Optional typical-route mission retained for trade studies

constraints._comment: Matching-diagram conditions. The current climb-rate-to-gradient conversions use preliminary reference climb speeds and should later be coupled directly to the performance model.

conditions.name: Water landing over 50-ft obstacle
conditions._src: Tidal Flight RFP requires the landing condition at MTOW, so beta = 1.0.

conditions.name: Best ROC at sea level
conditions._src: ROC from the Tidal Flight RFP. The 100-KTAS conversion speed is preliminary and must be replaced by the calculated best-ROC speed.

conditions.name: Best ROC at 10,000 ft
conditions._src: ROC and altitude from the Tidal Flight RFP. The 100-KTAS conversion speed is preliminary.

conditions.name: OEI ROC at sea level
conditions._src: ROC from the Tidal Flight RFP. The 90-KTAS conversion speed and stopped-propeller condition are preliminary analysis assumptions.

conditions.name: Balked landing
conditions._src: The RFP requires a balked landing but does not specify a gradient. G = 0.03 is a preliminary reference-analysis assumption.

conditions.name: Required 180-KTAS cruise capability
conditions._src: Tidal Flight RFP requires 180 KTAS at 10,000-ft density altitude. Beta = 0.95 is preliminary.
